pub const OCTAL_BOUND: i64 = 8;

pub type pdx_ratio_t = f32;

pub type pdx_measure_t = f64;

pub type pdx_wide_t = [u8; 16];

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct pdx_full_t {
    pub fixed: [u8; OCTAL_BOUND as usize],
    pub next: Option<Box<pdx_ratio_t>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum pdx_payload_t {
    Case1 {
        single: i32,
    },
    Case2 {
        text: String,
    },
    Case3 {
        text: String,
    },
    Default,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum pdx_inline_enum_t {
    VALUE_ONE = 1,
    VALUE_TWO = 2,
}
